maintenance_led.reason: MRO distribution of bearings, pumps, safety and industrial supplies plus repair services for customers' existing operating facilities and equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial firms in manufacturing, oil and gas, agriculture and construction, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Acquisitions are a significant part of growth history, but it mainly grows organically through distribution, service and supply chain sales.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly distributed MRO products from third-party brands, which customers can source elsewhere; some integrated supply and pump service stickiness.

notes: Serial-acquirer and switching-cost answers are judgment calls; DXP has made many acquisitions over time.
